UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Root identity document for all account sub-collections. Owners have full read/write access.

WalletAsset.title: Wallet Asset
WalletAsset.description: Cryptographic vault document. The 'primary-vault' ID is used for the deterministic root wallet. Owners have full read/write access.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Ledger entry for financial activity. Owners have read and create access.

/users/{userId}.description: Individual user profile root. Critical for security rules hierarchy.

/users/{userId}/assets/{assetId}.description: Secure vault assets locked to the specific user. The primary-vault ID is reserved for the root wallet.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{txId}.description: Private financial ledger for the authenticated user.
